limitations: All timed activations are deterministic synthetic data; actual imported model matrices do not make them captured graph inputs.
Successful bounded byte comparisons reproduce the evaluated AMD baseline only; the private fusion is not qualified for arbitrary inputs or independent original NVIDIA parity.
F168 activated-half and F32 W2-half are separate compiled diagnostics and do not observe original F152/F16 production pre-E4 bits.
Timing is isolated W1-W2 GPU spans, two baseline dispatches versus one candidate dispatch with compute barriers. W3, CPU, uploads/readback, graph, bridge, FSR, history and game are excluded.
Every pooled and paired operator median regressed; the screen stopped before actual-input capture, model checkpoints/head, quality, histories, native lifecycle or full-inference timing.
Summed operator medians and separate instrumented-profile cost bounds do not establish complete inference or game FPS.
The successful suites ran without Khronos validation layers; the explicit layer-enabled attempt failed before device creation.
Installed static matrix/register/LDS observations do not establish dynamic stalls, occupancy or the cause of regression.
NVIDIA DLLs, generated weights, raw tensors, profiler payloads and captures are excluded; core MIT and adapter GPL notices remain unchanged.
